issues.reason: This is acknowledged gap territory (no carrier exists for a vague-quantity duration on an eventuality) and (MeasureAtLeast (sk_persist $x) duration 2 week) is true of 'for several weeks' and well-typed — a lower bound the text entails, weakening rather than widening the claim — so the calibration line protects the extension of the bare-plural duration rule as graceful improvisation.

gaps_confirmed: vague-quantity DURATION on an eventuality ('for several weeks'): Measure / MeasureAtLeast take a stated figure and CardinalityPhrase records a vague amount only for a group that counts things, so the surface word has no carrier

the restitutive / directional 'back' in 'fade back into the cove' has no slot: Again is keyed to the word 'again', Manner takes how-adverbs only, and the phrasal-verb rule targets non-compositional verb+particle
new_gaps: A licensed form would need a duration-phrase companion mirroring CardinalityPhrase — (DurationPhrase <event> "several") beside the bound — so that 'for several weeks' and a bare 'for weeks' stop recording identically.
notes: The residual loss the issue points at — 'several' leaving no trace, so this parse is indistinguishable from one of 'for weeks' — is exactly the confirmed gap, not a defect in the parse. The rest is on-doctrine: bare-plural generic to a 0.9/0.9 distributing rule with no QuantifierPhrase, Experiencer for the stative 'persist', Patient for 'fade' (named on the internal-change list), Goal for 'into', Before with the earlier event first, and the definite cove typed at top level.
